notes: NVIDIA named as a returning investor in Mistral's EUR3B (~$3.5B) Series D, led by Samsung Electronics at a post-money valuation of >EUR21B (~$24B). Per-investor cheque size not disclosed by any party; amount_usd left blank rather than allocating the round total to NVIDIA. NVIDIA was already an existing Mistral backer, so this is additional capital into an existing position (follow_on), not a new stake. Corroborated by TechCrunch, Sifted, HPCwire, Yahoo Finance/Reuters syndication alongside Mistral's own announcement.
co_investors: Samsung Electronics (lead); EQT/Scaleup Europe Fund and PSG Equity (co-leads); Advent, BlackRock, Grand Duchy of Luxembourg (new); a16z, ASML, Bpifrance, Korelya Capital (returning)
